levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Football field, and only the Drive owner.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One of the two picks is right.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Both wrong, or no picks.

criterion: The rules: Knows where to test and who types where

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Top and side view; the ball's path from loading to leaving and the power source are both drawn.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One view only, or the power source or the ball's path is missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No sketch, or not a launcher.

criterion: Your concept sketch: The sketch shows how the launcher holds, powers and throws the ball, in a top and a side view

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every major part has a size and a process or stock item.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Some parts are labeled; sizes or processes are missing on others.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No sizes or processes.

criterion: Your concept sketch: Parts are labeled with sizes and how each is made

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Five criteria, weights total 50, every idea scored 1 to 5, and every criterion says what decided it.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One of those is missing: a reason, a score, or the weights do not total 50.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Fewer than five criteria, or several scores or reasons missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No table.

criterion: Score and pick (team): Weighted objectives table: 5 criteria, weights summing to 50, every idea scored, a reason on every criterion

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The reason names the total, or says why the team overrode it; every subsystem's meeting point is named with how they join.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The reason or the interfaces are vague (no total, or a meeting point missing).

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A pick with no reason from the table, and interfaces barely named.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No pick.

criterion: Score and pick (team): The pick is explained by the table, and the interfaces between the four parts are named
